properties.displayName: QC - Connector Offline Azure Active Directory
properties.description:
Identifies when the last time a logged event has been ingested into the clients workspace from the "Azure Active Directory" connector. Query then
checks the time the latest event was generated against the timespan specified in the associated watchlist. If the time generated of the latest
event indicates that it was generated before the specified time, an incident will be generate to prompt an investigation as to why the connector
hasn't ingested any events recently.
